content.short: Automated, risk-managed yield vaults for any asset on any chain, with $1.3B on the platform.
content.description: Concrete, built by Blueprint Finance, runs vaults where a quantitative system allocates, rebalances and compounds deposits across on-chain yield sources. Retail users deposit through the Earn app, institutions use its Enterprise product, and AssetCX lets assets stay with a centralized custodian while still earning on Concrete's rails. It reports $1.3 billion in assets and $23.5 billion processed, backed by Polychain, YZi Labs and VanEck.
content.meta: Concrete's automated vaults allocate and compound yield across DeFi, with $1.3B on platform and institutional options.
